Supreme Court Questions Centre on Tribunal Infrastructure

The Supreme Court has expressed serious concern over vacancies and the lack of proper infrastructure at National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT) Benches across India. Describing the NCLT and the National Company Law Appellate Tribunal (NCLAT) as the government's "lifeline," the court directed the Centre to identify the amenities required for the tribunals to function effectively.
